My experience at this so-called spa was absolutely pathetic and unacceptable.

If discounts are available, why show inflated prices on the menu and then charge something different? This kind of pricing practice is misleading and dishonest.
When I entered the massage room, things got even worse. The lady assigned to me arrived wearing a party-style dress, not professional spa attire. From the way she spoke and behaved, it was very clear she had no professionalism or proper massage training. She did not seem interested in providing a genuine massage at all.
Instead, she repeatedly tried to push extra services, crossing personal boundaries without hesitation. Her behavior was highly inappropriate and made me extremely uncomfortable. Despite clearly refusing multiple times, she continued insisting.
After I denied her repeatedly, she left the room and returned with someone who appeared to be a supervisor. Shockingly, instead of resolving the issue, the supervisor also tried to negotiate and push additional services, offering “special prices.” This felt more like bargaining in an illegal setup than being in a legitimate spa.
This place is not a professional spa by any standard. It is misleadingly advertised, poorly managed, and clearly running something very different under the name of a spa. I honestly don’t understand how the owner is allowed to operate such a place.
❌ Not recommended at all
❌ Avoid if you are looking for a genuine, professional massage
❌ Overall experience was extremely bad and uncomfortable
My advice to others: do not visit such places. Save your money and your dignity.
